hypotheses.justification: Split on 0 < p.1. In the positive case, compose source_positive_smooth H with the fiber inclusion; this lemma requires neither hS nor hpos. Otherwise the fiber source is identically zero: H.inputSupport and hpos make every nonzero real-projected input coefficient vanish throughout the domain where the radius is nonpositive. This property is preserved by the literal residual operations. In particular, a function vanishing on that half-space has zero total Fréchet derivative there, including at radius zero: any existing derivative vanishes by one-sided directional limits; a nonexistent derivative totalizes to zero (fderiv_zero_of_not_differentiableAt). HarmonicFields.derivativeCoefficient therefore preserves this vanishing, as do convolution, angular differentiation and real projection. The residual's zero mode is zero by ParticularWaveAssembly.residualSource_zero. Thus the nonpositive-radius fiber is constant zero, without any closedness assumption on S.
